The Cornell Crop and Pest Management Guidelines offer the latest information on topics such as pest management, crop production, and landscape plant maintenance. Each title is updated by Cornell University researchers and Extension specialists and is designed as a practical guide for agricultural and horticultural crop producers, landscape managers, crop consultants and industry advisers, Extension educators, Master Gardeners, or pesticide dealers. Titles currently available include:

<script src="https://cdn.auth0.com/js/auth0-spa-js/2.0/auth0-spa-js.production.js"></script>
<script>
async function checkPageAccess() {
    const authStatus = await checkAuth();
    const gateDiv = document.getElementById('auth-gate');
    const contentDiv = document.getElementById('content');
    
    if (authStatus.authenticated) {
        gateDiv.style.display = 'none';
        contentDiv.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
        gateDiv.innerHTML = `
            <div style="background: #fff3cd; border: 1px solid #ffc107; border-radius: 8px; 
                        padding: 20px 30px; margin: 2rem 0; display: flex; align-items: center; 
                        justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px;">
                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;">
                    <span style="font-size: 24px;">🔒</span>
                    <span style="color: #856404; font-size: 16px;">Sign in to access full content</span>
                </div>
                <button onclick="login()" 
                        style="background: #B31B1B; color: white; border: none; 
                               padding: 10px 24px; font-size: 16px; border-radius: 6px; 
                               cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap;
                               transition: background 0.2s;"
                        onmouseover="this.style.background='#8B1515'" 
                        onmouseout="this.style.background='#B31B1B'">
                    Sign In
                </button>
            </div>
        `;
    }
}

checkPageAccess();
</script>
